title: A model loop with a dollar budget refuses a second call after an unpriced answer, while an unbudgeted loop may continue
steps: S1: run a budgeted scripted model that returns a tool answer without cost and has a second answer ready, then resume from the saved answered turn.
S2: run the same first answer without budgetUsd.
expect: S1: AGENT_BUDGET_UNKNOWN is returned before the second call, and resume also dispatches no new call.
S2: the unbudgeted run dispatches both calls and reports one turn without cost.
evidence: The AI audit found that totalsOf(turns).cost sums known costs and an unknown cost contributed zero to the budget guard.
fence: An unknown provider cost is not treated as zero when deciding whether another budgeted model call may be dispatched.

tests: a conversation past its budget stops before the next call with AGENT_BUDGET
a budgeted conversation stops after a call whose cost is unknown, including on resume
an unbudgeted conversation can continue after a call whose cost is unknown
